questions.text: Do I need 10DLC registration just to text alerts to my own employees, and can a service handle that paperwork for us?
Will texts sent from an email-to-SMS service get filtered as spam by carriers, and how do we keep alerts from being blocked?
If an employee replies to an automated text alert, can that reply come back to my email inbox instead of a separate app?
Is it legal to text employees on their personal phones for work alerts, and what consent do we need first?
What happens to our text alerts if the email-to-SMS service goes down? Is there a fallback so nobody misses an urgent message?
